method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reverse reconstruction of the model/theory correspondence and preorder example, and exact formula, macro, controlled-token, identifier and reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Models, model theory and the axiomatic method; a two-sentence axiomatization of preorders; and first-order expressibility limits from compactness and Löwenheim–Skolem.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: After syntax and semantics are defined, model theory asks which structures satisfy a sentence set Gamma and which sentences characterize a structure or class. A structure satisfying Gamma is its model, and the axiomatic method describes a class by theory axioms; precisely the first-order consequences of the axioms hold in every model.
samples.checks: Both directions of investigation, model definition, characterization condition, model-theory domain, axiomatic method and consequence/model observation are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A preorder is a reflexive transitive relation R on A. Interpreting a binary predicate P as R on domain A yields a structure that models the displayed reflexivity and transitivity sentences exactly when R is a preorder; consequently first-order P-properties of all preorders correspond to consequences of those axioms.
samples.checks: Relation properties, structure assignments, both quantified axioms, symbolizations, biconditional model claim and proof-transfer conclusion are exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: First-order languages can express exact finite domain size and, with infinitely many sentences, infinitude. They cannot express finiteness or nonenumerability; these limitations follow from compactness and Löwenheim–Skolem.
samples.checks: Single-n size claims, infinite theory, two inexpressibility results and both named metatheorems are preserved.

source_observations: The target uses प्रतिमान only in the model-theoretic sense and उपपत्ती for theory, preserving the axioms/models distinction.
The preorder axioms retain reflexivity and the three-variable transitivity clause without changing quantifier nesting or predicate arguments.
All formulas, macros, controlled tokens, identifiers and references match exactly.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The expressibility claims are stated here without the later compactness and Löwenheim–Skolem proofs.
प्रतिमान उपपत्ती is a transparent compound from established terms; exact current disciplinary preference remains expert-reviewable.
